data.name: Diverse Training
data.description: You add your level to any soulknife levels to meet prerequisites of feats and blade skills.  You may also use any blade skills with a weapon summoned with call weaponry as if it were a mind blade.  You also add your level to any levels in a manifesting class for the purpose of meeting the prerequisites for feats.
